steps: Deployed the program to devnet (upgrade authority is the lab wallet)
register_provider campus-scout, task_types=1, non-zero peer id (provider GrRvaYzN…)
Fetched provider: authority is the lab wallet, name=campus-scout, task_types=1, jobs_completed=0
Fetched provider after update: name=campus-scout-v2, task_types=3
create_job escrowed 1_000_000 lamports against a lab-signed Ed25519 quote (job EHa3yQFK…, SOL mint, task_type=1)
consumer_confirm released the 1_000_000 lamports and closed the job; provider jobs_completed=1, total_earned=1000000
evidence.functional_evidence: register_provider and update_provider landed; create_job escrowed 1_000_000 lamports against a verified Ed25519 quote; provider_complete and consumer_confirm released the escrow, closed job EHa3yQFKUGkqt8ouamSGLhj5WRZGAhS77SMTx8cQCqm6, and set jobs_completed=1 / total_earned=1000000; NameTooShort and a second register were rejected.
evidence.ui_check: The hosted page is the generic IDL console (connect Phantom or Solflare on devnet). It was not driven in headless Chromium in this run; register_provider, update_provider, create_job, provider_complete and consumer_confirm were sent with the lab wallet through the IDL client in tests/devnet/qvac-marketplace.mjs.

limitations: refund_job and rotate_peer_id were not exercised. The lab wallet was both consumer and provider authority. payment_mint must be the default pubkey (SOL-only MVP).
standard_limitation: Practice-environment evidence records specified behaviour under stated conditions. It is not a security audit, a guarantee of current availability or an endorsement of production use.
